metadata_filter.note: retrieval indexes both statuses so the obsolete-source trap is answerable; forbidden sources are excluded at citation scoring via eval-case forbidden_source_ids

generation.prompt_template: Answer only from the supplied context. After each claim, cite the supporting context blocks in brackets like [1]. Cite every block you rely on. If the context does not establish the answer, say insufficient evidence.

identity.chunk_id_rule: sha256('chunk' + U+001F + document_id + U+001F + start + U+001F + end + U+001F + chunk_text)

quality_gates.note: gates frozen before rerun; citation-quality metrics are reported but deliberately not gated until the citation behavior is diagnosed
